grammar.summary: 本课以「学生恶作剧戏弄警察与工人」为线索，集中运用了被动语态、定语从句与分词短语作状语，并出现 Only when 倒装。重点体会叙事中如何用被动突出「被逮捕、被授予许可」，用定语从句补充人物，用 Only 倒装强调「只有……才」。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: 当要突出动作的承受者时用被动语态：be + 过去分词。本课用被动叙述「被逮捕、被授予许可、骗局被识破」，主语为承受者，语气客观。

examples.en: Permission was granted and a policeman accompanied him to a pay phone.
examples.cn: 警察同意了，陪他来到一个投币电话前。

examples.en: At this, the police pointed out ironically that this would hardly be necessary as the men were already under arrest.
examples.cn: 警察听后讥讽地说，这大可不必，因为他俩已被逮捕了。

examples.en: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
examples.cn: 当他看到那个工人真的是给警察挂电话，才恍然大悟，原来他们都成一场骗局的受害者。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 which/that 引导定语从句，which 指物。本课用 which 修饰骗局、恶作剧，用 that 修饰一切发生的事，补充说明。

examples.en: Inviting the fire Brigade to put out a nonexistent fire is a crude form of deception which no self-respecting student would ever indulge in.
examples.cn: 请消防队来扑灭一场根本没有的大火是一种低级骗局，有自尊心的大学生决不会去做。

examples.en: The student did in an archway nearby where he could watch and hear everything that went on.
examples.cn: 那个学生躲在附近一拱形的门廊里，在那儿可以看见、听到现场发生的一切。

examples.en: Students often create amusing situations which are funny to everyone except the victims.
examples.cn: 大学生们常常做的是制造一种可笑的局面，使大家笑上一场，当然受害者是笑不出来的。

points.title: Only when 倒装 (Inversion with Only when)
points.explanation: 把 Only + 状语从句置于句首时，主句需部分倒装（助动词提前）。本课用 Only when he saw... did he realize... 强调「只有当他看到……时才意识到」，突出恍然大悟的转折。

examples.en: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
examples.cn: 当他看到那个工人真的是给警察挂电话，才恍然大悟，原来他们都成一场骗局的受害者。

exercises.q: Permission ______ granted and a policeman accompanied him to a pay phone.
Inviting the fire Brigade to put out a nonexistent fire is a crude form of deception ______ no self-respecting student would ever indulge in.
Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police ______ he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
下列哪个词与课文中 hoax 的含义最接近？
用被动语态填空：At this, the police pointed out ironically that this would hardly be necessary as the men ______ already under arrest.（写出 be 的正确过去时形式）
